about_the_game:
In Project Rebearth, you rebuild the world together with other players. The game is set a thousand years into the future, after an unknown event wiped out civilization  nothing on the surface remained. Centuries have passed, and people are emerging to the surface once more. Play in a massive online multiplayer world where everyone shares the same exact 1:1 replica of planet Earth. Grow your town, trade with others for resources you can’t obtain on your own, face challenges, and uncover the lost history of the planet.

A day in Project Rebearth takes a day in real time. this means it is a game you play over multiple days and weeks, rather than finish it one afternoon. As your city grows, you unlock new features and gameplay mechanics in this world that never sleeps.

Start your adventure

  • Choose any spot on Earth to start your settlement,

  • Build in a variety of biomes, each with their own resources and challenges,

  • Gather materials and manage your inventory to keep your inhabitants happy and your town thriving,

  • Discover lost knowledge to expand your capabilities and unlock new possibilities,

  • Make choices that have long-term consequences for your settlement,

  • Launch expeditions to search for ancient artifacts and piece together the true history of the world,

  • Travel across the globe to see how other players are rebuilding their own societies,

A 1:1 replica of Earth

Project Rebearth takes place on a full-scale, 1:1 replica of our planet one thousand years into the future. You decide whether to start your settlement in the burning deserts, frozen polar regions, or wild temperate forests. Each real-world location has its own style, building materials, natural resources, and specialized production chains.

The world is your playground

Explore familiar and unfamiliar corners of the Earth. Get inspired by the creativity of other players, build freely in the sandbox mode of the game and export any location as a high-resolution map. Perfect for map-making or integrating into offline adventures like TTRPGs.

The world never sleeps

The world of Project Rebearth is persistent. The game is a relaxed, long-term game that is not meant to be rushed through in a weekend. Your farms keep growing potatoes, your woodcutters keep producing lumber, even while you’re offline. Play at your own pace, whenever it suits you.

The world that holds secrets

Send out expeditions to discover artifacts in the world. Little puzzle pieces that might hold the key to discovering how the world ended up the way it is now. What lead to the world being as empty as it is? Can you, together with other players, unravel the story of Project Rebearth?
